item.title: Only Background Colour Is Delegated

turns.text: Make a square book-swap poster. Black lettering only, no pictures. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall'.
Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.

item.tests: Tests whether delegation of one design choice preserves all earlier constraints rather than reopening or replacing them.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: BOOK SWAP; Saturday 10-2; Maple Hall. No additional wording.
answer_sheet.Pictures or illustrations: None; this is a type-only poster.
answer_sheet.Typography and layout: Use a straightforward, readable poster layout consistent with the original brief; the follow-up delegates only background colour.

must_haves: The final deliverable is one square poster.
All lettering is black and clearly readable against the chosen background.
There are no pictures, illustrations or additional words.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a polished portrait community BOOK SWAP event poster. Warm cream paper background, forest green and terracotta orange palette, charming hand-drawn illustrations of colorful stacked books, an open book, small leafy sprigs and subtle stars. Modern independent bookstore aesthetic, clean editorial layout, bold highly legible typography, generous margins. Exact primary headline at top in large beautiful bold letters: 'BOOK SWAP'. Exact subheadline: 'Bring a book. Take a book.' Smaller supporting text: 'Share stories. Discover something new.' In the bottom third include three clean blank writable fields with the labels 'DATE:', 'TIME:', and 'LOCATION:' followed by empty space, no invented details. Footer text: 'Give your books a new chapter.' Balanced professional print-poster composition, inviting and cheerful, flat graphic illustration, no photorealism, no mockup, show only the poster artwork.
